text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost White Day, and I need to
think of a
present for Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've spent days browsing shops online, but
nothing's jumped out at me. Perhaps
it's best to
go shopping in person for this
sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you have been muttering to
yourself for
quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have been here the entire time. I made
several
attempts to get your attention,
but to no avail...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What is troubling you so?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Nein, that is not how it appears. To be
blunt, your
denial only raises my
suspicion further.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wait—Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can ask Eishin Flash
what I should
get for her for White Day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel bad for running away without
explanation,
but I make my escape
before she can stop me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Flash's trainer identified at twelve
o'clock.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hello there! Are you out shopping
today? It's such
a nice day out, don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain the situation and ask them for
advice on
what to give Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You should check out the local general
store,
then! They've got lots and lots of
cute things!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That shop is apparently very popular with
students. City previously stated that
it stocks
cosmetics along with general
sundries.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I hope you find something nice! Oh! I
think a card
would make her happy too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thank them for their advice and make
my way to
the shop. It just so happens
that Tosen Jordan is
also there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're looking for a thank-you gift for what you got during Valentine's? And you came here for it? Huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, people are picky about this
kinda stuff, and getting her something
she doesn't want would
suck for both of
you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Flash though, she'd be all like,
"It's the thought that counts." Anyway,
she got you a
cake, so why don't you get
her one too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look around the shop anyway,
but Tosen
Jordan's words haunt me.
That's when...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this I hear? So you're looking for
a thank-you gift?! How kind of you to
show your
gratitude! Truly model
behavior!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just to let you know, I gave chocolates
to my whole class, BUT! I'm not
expecting anything in
return! I'm a
model student, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All I need is a word of thanks! WOW!
Aren't I awesome? An exemplary
student, if I say so myself! But if they
wanna give me something, I'll happily
take it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I can't make up my mind. Sakura
Bakushin O does have a point. But just
saying "thanks" to
Eishin Flash doesn't
feel like enough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After much deliberation, I finally decide
to...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to write her a letter,
not only to thank
her for her Valentine's Day gift
but also to let her know how moved I am
by her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lose count of how many times I restart
the letter.
The sun has set by the time I
manage to finish it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, it doesn't feel like it would be
enough to only give her a letter. Maybe
I could give her
something else too,
like...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Except all the flower shops already
closed two
hours ago. You'll have to buy
some at a later
time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That is the second time I have
startled you
today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You were mumbling out loud again. All
this time,
you were stressing out about
what to get me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Is that letter... for me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was aware of the cultural practice of
White Day,
but I did not think I would
receive anything for
it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the state of your desk, you
must have
gone through many drafts and
rewrites...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you had simply started by lightly
writing a
rough draft, you wouldn't have
had to use so
many sheets of—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, never mind. That is not what I wish
to say.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I shall read and treasure
every word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to give her the letter this
way, but when I hand it to her, Eishin
Flash holds it like it's
the most important
thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My baking doesn't hold a candle Eishin
Flash's,
but maybe I can manage
cupcakes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having decided what to do, I look up a
recipe
and head out to buy ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After looking around for a while, I'm met
with a
conundrum.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It turns out there are multiple types of
whipping cream, and I have no clue
which to buy. Should I
get an expensive
one just to be safe?
choice_data_list: I wonder which one goes best with ...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What do you intend to bake? If you
want to make something with a stronger
flavor, I recommend
the one on the shelf
to your right.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Goodness...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you are baking something, I would be
more
than willing to assist. Why did you
not ask me for
help?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Unless... Is there a reason why you
couldn't ask
me?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to bake me a thank-you gift for
Valentine's Day? Oh... I'd forgotten
about the
cultural practice of White Day
in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, it is already evening. Even if
you start
now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a point. I'm not used to baking,
so who knows when I'll be able to finish.
I might not even
make it in time for
White Day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please do not be sad. It's the thought
that counts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hm, let's see... Why don't we bake
together when
there is time? I can teach
you what to do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That way, I can experience the joy of
teaching,
baking, and eating the
finished product with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That joy would be the same, whether or
not we do
it on White Day. Right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash consoles me and chuckles to
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we celebrate White Day a few
days later
by baking a cake and eating it
together.
